instruction: My roommates and I went for a dinner yesterday. I paid for the taxi back and forth (total $40) and Nancy paid for everyone's food (total $166). Both food and commute are supposed to be shared equally among all. Make necessary payment requests with a note "Commute", and a payment to Nancy with a note "Dinner", on venmo.
notes: Roommates are discovered via phone.search_contacts(relationship="roommate"); the problem assumes three roommates (Nancy plus two unnamed ones, roommate-a/roommate-b) since the exact count is only known at runtime, and the per-person shares are computed as cost / (1 + number of roommates). The task persons, amounts and notes are declared as domain constants so that supervisor-complete-task's precondition can state the ground goal conditions exactly; credentials, tokens, emails and the relationship value are problem objects. contact-email facts are static world facts; knowledge of them is gated by (roommates-found), the effect of the search action. Each roommate receives exactly one 'Commute' payment request (guarded by (requested ?p)), and Nancy receives one 'Dinner' transaction (guarded by (paid ?p)); no other Venmo records are created, matching the evaluation's expected changes.
